O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon Your servant, Your Prophet, Your pure elect, Your friend, Your beloved and Your Messenger, our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, the pure, immaculate and untainted one, the blessed beloved; and upon his Family, his Companions, his wives, his progeny and the people of his household — by the number of every numbered thing that Your knowledge has encompassed, Your mercy has embraced, Your Book has reckoned and Your Pen has recorded; and by the number arrived at by multiplying every kind of numbered things that exist — the known, the understood, the heard, the seen, the weighed, the simple and the compound, and all that is unseen at every age, era, time and moment — by the like of the number of the countable kinds of all the various things among all created beings. And in every blink of an eye with which the first and the last ever blinked, that number; and in every glance, that number; and in every passing thought, that number; and in every flash, that number; and in every breath, that number — from the beginning of created things until the appointed Day; the number of every thing multiplied by the like of the number of all things, for ever and ever, through all ages, until the Day of Judgement; and the number of all that multiplied by the like of the prayers of all who ever invoked prayers upon him among the first and the last, among the dwellers of the heavens, the Throne and the earths, from the first of creation until the Day of Judgement; and the number of the sum of all that multiplied by the like of that number. Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Magnificent — that number. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, a praise that matches His favours and equals His increase — that number. There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah — that number. Praise be to Allah abundantly, and glory be to Allah morning and evening — that number. There is no power and no strength save by Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent — that number. And I seek forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, other than whom there is no god, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance — that number and many times over — for myself, my parents, my grandparents, their children, my teachers, all who seek refuge with me, my brothers and my relatives; for all who have been good to me, all who have asked me to pray for them, the one who composed this prayer and his parents, and all Muslims, the living among them and the dead.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّهِ وَبَرَكَتِهِ وَفَضْلِهِ أَتَوَجَّهُ وَأَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ أَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي إِرَادَتِي وَتَتَوَلَّى إِعَانَتِي وَتَغْفِرَ زَلَّتِي وَتُؤْنِسَ وَحْشَتِي وَتَقْضِيَ حَوَائِجِي كُلَّهَا قَضَاءً يَكُونُ لِي فِيهِ خَيْرُ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، مَحْفُوفًا بِالرِّعَايَةِ، مَلْحُوظًا بِخَصَائِصِ العِنَايَةِ، مَحْفُوظًا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الآفَاتِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma bihaqqihî wa barakatihî wa fadhlihî atawajjahu wa atawassalu bihî an tuballighanî irâdatî wa tatawallâ i`ânatî wa taghfira zallatî wa tu'nisa wahsyatî wa taqdhiya hawâ'ijî kullahâ qadhâ'an yakûnu lî fîhi khayrud-dunyâ wal-âkhirah, mahfûfan bir-ri`âyah, malhûzhan bikhashâ'ishil-`inâyah, mahfûzhan min jamî`il-âfâti birahmatika yâ arhamar-râhimîn, wa shallallâhu `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihî ajma`în.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, dengan hak, keberkahan, dan keutamaannya aku menghadap dan bertawasul kepada-Mu, agar Engkau menyampaikan aku pada apa yang kuinginkan, mengurus pertolongan bagiku, mengampuni kekhilafanku, menghibur kesepianku, dan menunaikan seluruh hajatku dengan penunaian yang di dalamnya terdapat kebaikan dunia dan akhirat bagiku — diliputi pemeliharaan, diperhatikan dengan kekhususan inayah, dan terjaga dari segala bencana, dengan rahmat-Mu wahai Yang Paling Penyayang di antara para penyayang. Dan semoga Allah melimpahkan shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad serta seluruh keluarga dan sahabat beliau.
passages.en: O Allah, by his right, his blessing and his merit I turn to You and seek his intercession, that You bring me to what I intend, take charge of helping me, forgive my slips, console my loneliness, and fulfil all my needs with a fulfilment in which lies for me the good of this world and the next — surrounded by Your care, watched over by the special favours of Your providence, and protected from every affliction, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful. And may Allah bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad and upon all his Family and Companions.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأَمِينِ، المَبْعُوثِ رَحْمَةً لِلعَالَمِينَ، صَلَاةً تُفَرِّجُ بِهَا عَنَّا مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ مِنْ أُمُورِ دِينِنَا وَدُنْيَانَا وَأُخْرَانَا، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-amîn, al-mab`ûtsi rahmatan lil-`âlamîn, shalâtan tufarriju bihâ `annâ mâ nahnu fîhi min umûri dîninâ wa dunyânâ wa ukhrânâ, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihî wa sallim.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, nabi yang terpercaya, yang diutus sebagai rahmat bagi seluruh alam — shalawat yang dengannya Engkau melapangkan kami dari apa yang kami hadapi dalam urusan agama, dunia, dan akhirat kami — serta kepada keluarga dan sahabat beliau, dan limpahkanlah salam.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad, the trustworthy Prophet sent as a mercy to the worlds — a prayer by which You relieve us of whatever we face in the affairs of our religion, our worldly life and our afterlife — and upon his Family and Companions, and grant them peace.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لِقَلْبِي طِبًّا وَدَوَاءً، وَلِبَصَرِي نُورًا وَضِيَاءً، وَلِبَدَنِي عَافِيَةً وَشِفَاءً، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin shalâtan takûnu liqalbî thibban wa dawâ'â, wa libasharî nûran wa dhiyâ'â, wa libadanî `âfiyatan wa syifâ'â, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihî wa sallim.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — shalawat yang menjadi obat dan penyembuh bagi hatiku, cahaya dan sinar bagi penglihatanku, serta kesehatan dan kesembuhan bagi tubuhku — serta kepada keluarga dan sahabat beliau, dan limpahkanlah salam.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad — a prayer that is healing and remedy for my heart, light and radiance for my sight, and well-being and cure for my body — and upon his Family and Companions, and grant them peace.

passages.id_: Tiga redaksi shalawat atas Nabi ﷺ, karya Habib Muhammad bin Aidarus al-Habsyi
passages.en: Three formulas of prayer upon the Prophet ﷺ, by Habib Muhammad bin Aydarus al-Habashi

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلَاةً تُذْهِبُ بِهَا أَحْزَانِي، وَتُثَبِّتُ بِهَا جَنَانِي، وَتُطَهِّرُ بِهَا لِسَانِي، وَتُقَوِّي بِهَا أَرْكَانِي، وَأَتَقَلَّبُ بِسِرِّهَا فِيمَا عَنَانِي، فِي سِرِّي وَإِعْلَانِي، وَتَعُودُ بَرَكَاتُهَا عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى أَهْلِي وَأَوْلَادِي وَإِخْوَانِي، وَقَرَابَاتِي وَأَصْحَابِي وَجِيرَانِي، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma yâ rabba sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, as'aluka bihaqqi sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, an tushalliya `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, shalâtan tudzhibu bihâ ahzânî, wa tutsabbitu bihâ janânî, wa tuthahhiru bihâ lisânî, wa tuqawwî bihâ arkânî, wa ataqallabu bisirrihâ fîmâ `anânî, fî sirrî wa i`lânî, wa ta`ûdu barakâtuhâ `alayya wa `alâ ahlî wa aulâdî wa ikhwânî, wa qarâbâtî wa ash-hâbî wa jîrânî, innaka `alâ kulli syay'in qadîr, birahmatika yâ arhamar-râhimîn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, wahai Tuhan junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, aku memohon kepada-Mu dengan hak junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, agar Engkau melimpahkan shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — shalawat yang dengannya Engkau menghilangkan kesedihanku, meneguhkan hatiku, menyucikan lisanku, dan menguatkan anggota tubuhku; yang dengan rahasianya aku dapat menghadapi segala yang menyusahkanku, baik secara rahasia maupun terang-terangan; dan keberkahannya kembali kepadaku, keluargaku, anak-anakku, saudara-saudaraku, kerabatku, para sahabatku, dan tetanggaku. Sesungguhnya Engkau Mahakuasa atas segala sesuatu — dengan rahmat-Mu, wahai Yang Paling Penyayang di antara para penyayang.
passages.en: O Allah, Lord of our master Muhammad and of the Family of our master Muhammad, I ask You by the right of our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad that You bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad — a prayer by which You remove my sorrows, make my heart firm, purify my tongue and strengthen my limbs; by whose secret I may move freely through whatever concerns me, in secret and in public; and whose blessings return upon me, my household, my children, my brethren, my relatives, my companions and my neighbours. Truly You have power over all things — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النِّعَمِ الَّتِي أَفَضْتَهَا عَلَى قَلْبِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى قُلُوبِ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِي سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَتُرْضِي آلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَتُقَرِّبُنَا بِهَا إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، حَتَّى نَلْقَاكَ وَأَنْتَ رَاضٍ عَنَّا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ âli sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadan-ni`amil-latî afadhtahâ `alâ qalbi sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ qulûbi âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, shalâtan turdhîka wa turdhî sayyidanâ Muhammadan wa turdhî âla sayyidinâ Muhammad, wa tuqarribunâ bihâ ilayka wa ilâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, hattâ nalqâka wa anta râdhin `annâ yâ arhamar-râhimîn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan kepada keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebanyak bilangan nikmat yang Engkau curahkan ke dalam hati junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan ke dalam hati keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — shalawat yang meridakan-Mu, meridakan junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, dan meridakan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, serta yang dengannya Engkau mendekatkan kami kepada-Mu dan kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad beserta keluarganya, hingga kami berjumpa dengan-Mu dalam keadaan Engkau rida kepada kami, wahai Yang Paling Penyayang di antara para penyayang.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad and upon the Family of our master Muhammad, by the number of the blessings You poured upon the heart of our master Muhammad and upon the hearts of the Family of our master Muhammad — a prayer that pleases You, pleases our master Muhammad and pleases the Family of our master Muhammad, and by which You bring us near to Yourself and to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, until we meet You while You are well pleased with us, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى الشَّمْسِ المُنِيرَةِ، المُعَبَّرِ عَنْهَا بِحِجَابِ الغِيرَةِ، فِي الفَرْقِ وَالجَمْعِ، وَالعَطَاءِ وَالمَنْعِ، وَالخَفْضِ وَالرَّفْعِ، فَهُوَ الوَاسِطَةُ العُظْمَى، فِي جَمِيعِ مَظَاهِرِ الصِّفَاتِ وَالأَسْمَا، صَلَّى اللهُ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ المُتَدَرِّعِينَ بِأَنْوَارِ جَلَالِهِ وَجَمَالِهِ وَكَمَالِهِ، المُتَلَقِّينَ مِنْهُ بِكُلِّ آلَةٍ فِي كُلِّ حَالَةٍ، حَتَّى نَابُوا عَنْهُ فِي مَقَامِ الدَّلَالَةِ، وَتَحَمُّلِ أَعْبَاءِ الرِّسَالَةِ، وَعَلَى صَحْبِهِ نُجُومِ الاهْتِدَاءِ وَمَعَالِمِ الاقْتِدَاءِ، وَعَلَى مَنْ تَبِعَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ، إِلَى لِقَاءِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim wa bârik `alasy-syamsil-munîrah, al-mu`abbari `anhâ bihijâbil-ghîrah, fil-farqi wal-jam`, wal-`athâ'i wal-man`, wal-khafdhi war-raf`, fahuwal-wâsithatul-`uzhmâ, fî jamî`i mazhâhirish-shifâti wal-asmâ, shallallâhu wa sallama `alayhi wa `alâ âlihil-mutadarri`îna bi'anwâri jalâlihî wa jamâlihî wa kamâlih, al-mutalaqqîna minhu bikulli âlatin fî kulli hâlah, hattâ nâbû `anhu fî maqâmid-dalâlah, wa tahammuli a`bâ'ir-risâlah, wa `alâ shahbihî nujûmil-ihtidâ'i wa ma`âlimil-iqtidâ', wa `alâ man tabi`ahum bi'ihsân, ilâ liqâ'ir-rahmâni yâ arhamar-râhimîn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat, salam, dan keberkahan kepada matahari yang bersinar, yang diungkapkan sebagai hijab kecemburuan ilahi — dalam perpisahan dan penghimpunan, dalam pemberian dan penahanan, dalam perendahan dan peninggian — sebab dialah perantara teragung pada seluruh penampakan sifat dan nama. Semoga Allah melimpahkan shalawat dan salam kepadanya serta kepada keluarganya yang berselimutkan cahaya keagungan, keindahan, dan kesempurnaannya, yang menerima darinya dengan segala perangkat dalam setiap keadaan, sehingga mereka menggantikannya pada maqam penunjukan dan pemikulan beban risalah; serta kepada para sahabatnya, bintang-bintang petunjuk dan tanda-tanda keteladanan; dan kepada setiap orang yang mengikuti mereka dengan kebaikan, hingga perjumpaan dengan Ar-Rahman, wahai Yang Paling Penyayang di antara para penyayang.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers, peace and blessing upon the shining sun, spoken of as the veil of divine jealousy — in separation and in union, in giving and withholding, in lowering and raising — for he is the greatest intermediary in all the manifestations of the Attributes and the Names. May Allah bestow prayers and peace upon him and upon his Family, who clothe themselves in the lights of his majesty, his beauty and his perfection, and who receive from him with every faculty in every state, until they stood in his stead in the station of guidance and in bearing the burdens of the message; and upon his Companions, the guiding stars and landmarks of emulation; and upon all who follow them in excellence, until the meeting with the Most Merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
